description: This file defines theming functions for a UI, including a base theme with colors, typography, and elevation, as well as functions to generate categorical color palettes and map categories to colors. It provides visual styling tokens for a front-end project.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens including colors, typography, radii, and elevation levels.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Generates a deterministic color palette seeded by Ocean theme colors for categorical data, ensuring contrast and distinction for up to N categories.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Creates a mapping from category names to colors using the categorical palette, preserving input order, useful for consistent category coloring.
